question: Does escape's permission to cast a card from my graveyard change when I may cast the spell?

expected.shortAnswer: No: escape's permission does not change when you may cast the spell from your graveyard.
expected.answer: Escape’s permission doesn’t change when you may cast the spell from your graveyard.
